subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-13 (kb/Work PB530), both sentences, RE-DERIVED on the tree rather than inherited. SENTENCE 1 ('+' or '-' shall be either the leftmost or the rightmost symbol in character-string-1) needs no rule of its own and is carried by 13.18.40.6 Table 10: a lone sign is a NON-FLOATING sign whose two roles are 'the first symbol' and 'the last symbol', the leading-sign ROW is entirely blank (nothing may precede one) and the trailing-sign COLUMN is entirely blank (nothing may follow one). Measured on this tree at all four editions: 01 W1 PIC 9+9 and 01 W1 PIC 99-9 are COBOL1935 at --std 85 / 2002 / 2014 / 2023 (they used to bind and render MOVE 12 as [1+2]); the legal control PIC +999 still binds and renders [+012]. Witness PD05 of negative/pb528-picture-precedence. SENTENCE 2 (two extended editing sign control symbols: the first EDITING phrase for the leftmost symbol, the second for the rightmost) is NOT a Table-10 relation between the two symbols and is enforced AS WRITTEN in PictureAnalyzer.ValidateEditing over the FOR-form phrase LIST, COBOL1984: with two extended symbols the first phrase's character-1 IS the character-string's first symbol and the second's IS its last (kb/Work PB855). `PIC F999.99L` with the phrases reversed is rejected (it used to render MOVE -1.5 as [)001.50(]; the conforming order renders [(001.50)], golden 2023/pb530_picture_editing_order_2023 E01), Annex D.24's `PIC IS L9999.99F` and `PIC L99F` bind, and `PIC LF$999` (two extended symbols ahead of the currency symbol) and `PIC 9L9F` (a mid-string pair) are COBOL1984 (negative/pb855-picture-editing-es-two-before-cs, pb530-picture-editing-phrase-order PO02). || DETERMINATION (kb/Work PB855, REPLACING PB530's): PB530 read 'the leftmost symbol in character-string-1' as the leftmost OF THE TWO extended symbols (a phrase-ORDER rule) because 13.18.40.6's closing sentence - 'the precedence of es ... has the same precedence as the cs symbol in the column and row of non-floating insertion symbols' - 'cannot be applied literally' against Table 10's blank leading-currency-before-trailing-currency cell and would reject Annex D.24's `PIC IS L9999.99F`. The premise held for the cell and not for the reading: PictureComposition.Precedence now gives a NON-FLOATING FOR-form character-1 the cs roles (CurrencyLeading / CurrencyTrailing) against every symbol but another currency-like one, whose order SR25 and SR26 own (the walk exempts that one pair of roles), so the strict reading refuses nothing the standard shows. A SINGLE extended symbol is therefore a Table-10 question, not an unconstrained one: `PIC 99L99` is COBOL1935 (negative/pb855-picture-editing-es-mid-string), `PIC 9999L`, `PIC L999`, `PIC L$999`, `PIC 999$L` bind. The IS form (simple insertion, rule 3) has no Table-10 precedence and stays transparent; a FLOATING extended string is floating insertion and 13.18.40.6 states the cs mapping for the non-floating column and row alone, so it stays transparent too. Accepted by the reading that rejects LESS, not refused: `PIC $L99` and `PIC 999L$` (the cs/es order Table 10's blank cell would refuse; no sentence of the standard does). || editions: sentence 1 at 85, 2002, 2014, 2023; sentence 2 at 2023 only (the EDITING phrase is a COBOL-2023 introduction, Annex E.3.3 item 19), whose below-2023 gate is negative/pb490-picture-editing-at-85. retired-witness: unit:PictureCompositionTests.AConformingExtendedEditingPhraseOrder_IsAccepted (renamed AConformingExtendedEditingPlacement_IsAccepted by kb/Work PB855: it now holds the placements SR25/SR26 sanction (a pair at the two ends, a single symbol where a currency symbol may stand), no longer 'a mid-string pair and a single mid-string symbol are legal', which PB855 refused)
